derived_data.name: Upstream Integrated Country-Year Panel (retired)
derived_data.description: Historical 22,096-row merged panel (288 countries, 1990-2023) built from all upstream sources. No longer the analysis input; retained only for provenance of the retired pipeline.
derived_data.redistribution_note: Contains output derived in part from WVS data. Redistribution is not cleared until the author/data steward confirms that the applicable Conditions of Use permit this specific mixed-source output; aggregation alone does not establish permission.

derived_data.name: Canonical Analytical Panel (83 countries, 207 complete-case country-years)
derived_data.description: Complete-case analytical sample: 207 country-year observations across 83 countries, 1990-2023. One row per country-year; no scenario replication. Contains only country-year aggregated values, no individual-level microdata.
derived_data.redistribution_note: Contains output derived in part from WVS data. Redistribution is not cleared until the author/data steward confirms that the applicable Conditions of Use permit this specific mixed-source output; aggregation alone does not establish permission.

action_items.description: WVS individual wave files (WV1–WV6), WVS Time Series, WVS Wave 7, and EVS/WVS Joint dataset carry redistribution restrictions. Before public release: either (a) exclude these files from the public repository and document download instructions, or (b) obtain written redistribution permission from WVS Association.
action_items.resolution: rawdata/.gitignore excludes the WVS/EVS files from version control. LICENSE § 3 documents the current Conditions of Use. REPLICATION_RUNBOOK § 9 provides current official access instructions; derived-output permission remains open.
